processing.description: Quoted from Executive summary, p. 3215. The quote was found in the text of page 5 of the snapshot (sha256 166e10a66b4d…) before publishing.
Value: "increase in 2025 by 1.0 % relative to 2024" is published as +1.0 percent for 2025. The paper's range (0.2 % to 1.7 %) is stated in the scope, not published as values.

published_value.quote: Global fossil CO₂ emissions (including cement carbonation) are expected to further increase in 2025 by 1.0 % relative to 2024 (range 0.2 % to 1.7 %)

scope.basis: Fossil fuels and industry including the cement carbonation sink (net), with international aviation and shipping. The paper states that its growth rates are adjusted for the extra day in the leap year 2024. A projection from preliminary data for 2025; the paper gives the range 0.2 to 1.7 percent.

title: Projected change in fossil carbon dioxide emissions, 2024 to 2025 (Global Carbon Budget)
